source.scope: Matched baseline/candidate instrumented exports on one Windows runner. Each action starts a new process. Retained and Load use the same r1-baseline-fresh profile after real manual Save and Autosave. Verbose engine logging is enabled equally to identify shutdown resources. OS caches are not cleared.

limitations: Four AB/BA/AB/BA repetitions on one Windows runner; no cold OS cache or statistical certainty claim.
Full manual Save includes opening save UI/live capture and prepare+commit; not physical button-to-paint latency.
Load timing includes observer capture/hashes; all variants identical overlay.
Typical caption value is each run median of authored captions003–030; all 28 raw values retained.
Named checkpoint arrival timing not measured.
Inclusive counters overlap; never sum nested write counters.
